description: Exact documented event and BI forwarding GET endpoint. Scoped warning checks preserve open identity applicability and metadata strings; regional creative and video callbacks are excluded.

params.name: app_id
params.description: Documented mandatory store app identifier. Preserve Android package names and iTunes identifiers without inferring a shared numeric grammar.

params.name: event
params.description: Documented mandatory event name. Examples do not close the event vocabulary.

params.name: partner
params.description: Documented mandatory tracking partner name; registration is external.

params.name: key
params.description: Documented mandatory partner key issued by Remerge; no local issuance or acceptance check.

params.name: ts
params.description: Optional event Unix epoch timestamp is documented as ten digits in UTC. No freshness window is inferred.

params.name: idfa
params.description: Optional local format advisory for the documented uppercase Apple IDFA. Cross-platform mandatory labels do not establish when this ID is applicable.

params.name: aaid
params.description: Optional local format advisory for the documented lowercase Android Advertising ID. No simultaneous Apple and Android ID requirement is inferred.

params.name: idfv
params.description: The vendor ID is described as applicable to iOS only. Applicability, alternatives and the mandatory table label require integration context.

params.name: data
params.description: The guide allows event metadata as JSON or a single string. No JSON-only syntax or custom-member schema is imposed.

params.name: non_app_event
params.description: Optional literal true or false. BI forwarding requires true when caller context establishes a non-app event; that context cannot be inferred from an event name.

params.name: country
params.description: Optional ISO alpha-2 country-code shape only. Registry membership and geographic truth are not checked.

params.name: currency
params.description: Optional advice for current or historical ISO 4217 assignment. Case is not restricted and no currency/value conversion or account configuration is inferred.

params.name: device_name
params.description: Optional Device name.

params.name: os_name
params.description: Optional OS name; android and ios are examples, not a closed enumeration.

params.name: os_version
params.description: Optional OS version.

params.name: app_version
params.description: Optional Application version.

params.name: user
params.description: Optional Customer user ID.

params.name: revenue
params.description: Optional monetary-number sanity advice. The guide documents monetary units but not the complete receiver lexer; signed, fractional, leading-zero and exponent forms remain accepted. No value conversion or relationship between the two carriers is inferred.

params.name: revenue_float
params.description: Optional monetary-number sanity advice. The guide documents monetary units but not the complete receiver lexer; signed, fractional, leading-zero and exponent forms remain accepted. No value conversion or relationship between the two carriers is inferred.

params.name: operator
params.description: Optional Mobile operator or carrier.

params.name: zipcode
params.description: Optional Regional postal code.

params.name: city
params.description: Optional City name; UN/LOCODE standardization is guidance.

params.name: country_subdivision
params.description: Optional State or subdivision name.

params.name: partner_device_id
params.description: Optional Partner user ID.

params.name: ip
params.description: Optional IPv4 or IPv6 literal syntax advice. Address ownership, forwarding provenance and collection acceptance remain external.

params.name: language
params.description: Optional Simple or extended language value; examples admit both hyphen and underscore.

params.name: sdk
params.description: Optional Client SDK version.

rules.message: Remerge documents HTTPS for event forwarding.

params.name: method
params.description: The public event-forwarding interface documents GET.
